questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.learningObjective: Compute sector area
questions.stem: In the historical case, a sector has radius ten and central angle seventy-two degrees; what is its area to two decimals?
questions.explanation: Sector area equals pi times one hundred times seventy-two over three hundred sixty, about sixty-two point eight three.
questions.hint: Use fraction of full circle area.
